g.text: Chapter 23 on one page: the marquee case and its winning move
nine cases; each row names the move that made the answer strong
the move that made it strong
one persona, justified; a value vs complexity matrix
a shortlist of apps, scored before features
segment, then split the step that moved
decompose income; confirm with a time-of-day cut
verify against actuals, then act in two steps
competitor anchors, then a stated premium
rate impact, pick the two High pains
trips x fare; the break-even between offers
AARRR order; activation as a payment event
clarify, structure, quantify, then close with a fix and a metric
